description: Fast, accurate, and comprehensive multiline text measurement and layout library for JavaScript/TypeScript — without DOM reflow. Use when the user needs to calculate paragraph heights, line counts, manual line layouts (text flowing around floated images), or rich text rendering (emoji, CJK, RTL) on DOM, Canvas, or SVG targets. Covers npm install, core API (prepare/layout, prepareWithSegments/layoutWithLines), and options (whiteSpace, wordBreak, letterSpacing). Triggers on: pretext, text measurement, text layout, paragraph height, line layout, text reflow, canvas text measurement, DOM reflow.
